author: toketrain
body:
Jailhouse is a map built by TravelerRudy and myself. This map is very unique in the fact that it much of the action goes on indoors. Each quadrant of this map represents a cell block. The letters on the walls are different for each one, A, B, C, and D. Each is made of the same amount of material so as not to be unfair. This map is different (in some respects) from the other Walls maps found on Avicus, and this may present a new type of play for users. There are plenty of trees on the map, a mine, hidden chests, and adventure. Other images of this map can be found here.

It does have a completed map.yml, which can be found in the download.
The map can be downloaded here. 

Thank you for your consideration. Feedback would be appreciated as well as suggestions and constructive criticism. Stay cool Avicus.

Edit: More pics here!
